name: Rust target directories for inactive-project review
description: Find target directories within an explicitly authorized development workspace whose parents contain Cargo.toml and whose contents meet the retention conditions.

risk.rebuild_note: Usually reproducible with cargo build when source files, the toolchain, and dependencies remain available. Rebuilding may take time.
limitations: Assumes no custom CARGO_TARGET_DIR; review separately when that setting is present.
Modification times do not prove inactivity or that all contents are reproducible.
Exclude directories containing manually saved files, unique deliverables, or other non-reproducible data.
